premise: The station sets free a CubeSat no bigger than a lunchbox; it unfolds and sends its first message to the school on Earth whose children built it.
inspiration: 'Tom Thumb' (English folk tale), the tiny hero sent out into the big world, turned: the little one is sent out on purpose, and does exactly its job.
lesson: Small things built with care can do big jobs.
learning: CubeSats are tiny satellites, some no bigger than a loaf of bread, and some are built by schoolchildren.

en-US.title: Smaller Than a Lunchbox
en-US.text: {station:float loop 0.3} {capsule:float loop 0.3} {cubesat:float loop 0.3} High above the Moon, the {station:enter} space station had a tiny passenger. It was a {cubesat:enter} CubeSat, no bigger than a lunchbox. And it had been built on Earth, by the children of one small school. [curious] Today was its big day. {station:live} The station turned its arrays to the Sun. {sfx:click} Then, with a gentle click, out floated the little CubeSat into space. {cubesat:spin} [short pause] For a moment it just tumbled. Nearby, a {capsule:enter} capsule waited, as if holding its breath. {cubesat:live hold} Then, snap, snap! Out came its two solar panels, and up went its thin antenna. [excited] {cubesat:sparkle} It worked! {sfx:beep} Beep. Beep. Its first message went down to Earth. {capsule:pulse} In one small school, a whole classroom cheered. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} And everyone watching from the Moon cheered too. [warmly] {station:glow 0.4} The smallest satellite in the sky. And the proudest.

es-ES.title: Más pequeño que una fiambrera
es-ES.text: {station:float loop 0.3} {capsule:float loop 0.3} {cubesat:float loop 0.3} Muy por encima de la Luna, la {station:enter} estación espacial llevaba un pasajero diminuto. Era un {cubesat:enter} CubeSat, no más grande que una fiambrera. Y lo habían construido en la Tierra los niños y niñas de un colegio pequeñito. [curious] Hoy era su gran día. {station:live} La estación giró sus paneles hacia el Sol. {sfx:click} Entonces, con un clic suave, el pequeño CubeSat salió flotando al espacio. {cubesat:spin} [short pause] Durante un momento solo daba vueltas. Cerca, una {capsule:enter} cápsula esperaba, como conteniendo el aliento. {cubesat:live hold} Y entonces, ¡clac, clac! Abrió sus dos paneles solares y sacó su fina antena. [excited] {cubesat:sparkle} ¡Funcionaba! {sfx:beep} Bip. Bip. Su primer mensaje bajó hasta la Tierra. {capsule:pulse} En un colegio pequeñito, toda una clase lo celebró. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} Y todos los que miraban desde la Luna, también. [warmly] {station:glow 0.4} El satélite más pequeño del cielo. Y el más orgulloso.

click.prompt: a gentle mechanical click and a soft spring release

beep.prompt: two short bright electronic beeps, small and cheerful
